subject: CodeRefresher July 🏟️ — voice answers & this month's champion
preheader: Your résumé can now hear you talk. Plus: July's top performer and how much the arena grew.
intro: The arena got louder this month — literally. Here's everything that shipped and who's on top.

blocks.title: Voice answers in the Résumé Interview
blocks.body: Stop typing, start talking. Answer the AI's grilling out loud like a real interview — you'll get **delivery feedback** on top of substance, and yes, we notice if you alt-tab to Google.

blocks.alt: Me explaining my résumé claims to the AI interviewer
blocks.caption: "led the migration" — the AI: prove it.

blocks.title: Pick your battle length
blocks.body: Mock interviews now come in 5, 10 or 15-question rounds. Quick warm-up before standup or a full gauntlet — your call.

blocks.alt: Choosing the 5-question round at 11:58pm to keep the streak
blocks.caption: streak preservation is a legitimate strategy 🔥

blocks.title: One more thing
blocks.body: New members now get a proper **welcome to the arena** the moment they join — dark mode friendly, obviously. Know someone grinding for interviews? Send them in.
